title: Aojia Clothes hanging rack
text: Aojia Clothes hanging rack. I did not care for this but shipping cost too much to return. Too many pieces, poor instructions, and very flimsy. You can only put a couple of garments on it without it tipping over. A waste of time to put together. I would not recommend it.

description: Are your closets overflowing? Solve your storage needs with Whitmor's Adjustable Garment Rack. Since the height adjusts from 36-inches to 61-inches it is the perfect choice for short or extra long garments. Great for storing special occasion or seasonal garments or to hang freshly laundered clothing in your laundry room. This unit includes a durable chromed steel hanging rod and is easy to assemble.
